0022600141.text: The San Antonio Spurs (1-2) visit the Utah Jazz (1-3) in the 5th game of the Spurs' season, sitting 9th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Southwest after winning their only road game while going 0-2 at home. Utah, 13th in the West and 3 games back in the Northwest, has lost its last two games, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 126-109 win in Salt Lake City on January 22. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), with Jaxson Hayes (shoulder soreness) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions.
